headline: Schwarber's two homers power Phillies past Twins
recap: The Phillies beat the Twins 7-1 in the Field of Dreams game at Dyersville, Iowa on Thursday. Philadelphia scored two runs in the first inning, three in the fourth and two more in the seventh; Minnesota's only run came on a second-inning home run by Luke Keaschall off Aaron Nola. Nola (W, 4-9) struck out nine over five innings. Kyle Schwarber went 2-for-5 with two home runs and three RBIs, and Brandon Marsh added a two-run homer while going 2-for-2 with two walks and a stolen base. Trea Turner and Alec Bohm each doubled, and four Phillies relievers — Brooks Raley, Jonathan Bowlan, Orion Kerkering and Jhoan Duran — combined for four scoreless innings to close it out. Twins starter Taj Bradley (L, 9-5) allowed five runs over four innings.
Philadelphia is 65-58, second in the NL East, 9 games behind the first-place Braves, and is riding a one-game winning streak.

The Phillies are off Friday before the series continues at Target Field in Minneapolis on Saturday. Jesus Luzardo is set to start for Philadelphia opposite Minnesota's Connor Prielipp, with first pitch at 7:10 PM ET. A betting line was not yet available.
